Surfaces.Contract: Start the caller owner before validation or command construction. Keep it through dispatch, native result inspection, typed conversion and cleanup. Delegated methods borrow it; cache hits and successful calls keep the default failure-only owner.

Boundaries.Name: internal-failover-probe
Boundaries.Contract: Begin independent failure-only ownership before probe preflight; retain it through health bookkeeping and completion without publishing a caller failure.

NonRoutes.Reason: Local value construction, validation, formatting, comparison or state inspection; no command dispatch.
